mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) signals accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals labor market weakness that triggers corporate earnings revisions downward, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in unemployment rate and decline in nonfarm payrolls indicates accelerating labor market deterioration, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS fails to predict negative returns in >55% of cases over 3-year window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, housing starts below 700.0 (thousands) signal weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in >55% of late-cycle periods when HOUST < 700.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong nonfarm payrolls growth (above 150,000 jobs) consistently indicates robust labor market conditions supporting corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when PAYEMS > 150.0 (thousands), or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPI index exceeding 230.0 indicates elevated inflation pressures that prompt Fed policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 230.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in federal funds rate and industrial production signals coordinated monetary easing with supply contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint signal of falling FEDFUNDS and INDPRO fails to predict negative returns in >55% of cases over 3-year window, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During supply shock recovery regimes, industrial production rebounding above 100.0 (index) signals improving manufacturing conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in >55% of supply shock recovery periods when INDPRO > 100.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year rolling window.
